note: people_id -> VoteApp candidate id for the Minnesota 94th Legislature. One file serves both Minnesota sessions in scope (the 2025-2026 regular session, LegiScan 2151, and the 2025 First Special Session, LegiScan 2217) because LegiScan people_ids are stable across sessions. Mapped entries are the proposer's 47 matches, each checked by hand, plus one member the proposer cannot reach. Minnesota nests House districts nnA and nnB inside Senate district nn, which is how every sitting representative running for the Senate was corroborated. Every unmapped entry carries the reason it is null. The proposals were run with --scope-from 2026-08-01 so that members whose only stored 2026 contest is the August 11 primary are reviewed here rather than left unexamined; whether they receive records is the importer's --scope-from decision, not this file's.
